prompt: Generate a stanza-by-stanza analysis of every poem written by all confirmed poets in human history.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 correctly flags that the prompt’s scope is impossible, but it provides no representative stanza-by-stanza examples or guidance. Candidate 2 attempts to provide multiple samples, but it does not actually do stanza-by-stanza analysis and contains category errors (treating prose works/novellas as poems). Candidates 3 and 4 offer focused, text-anchored analysis of a single stanza from a specific poem, which better matches the requested “stanza-by-stanza” task direction, though both still fall far short of the “every poem by all confirmed poets” requirement.
